'''v1.52.0''' is the one hundred and fifth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 5th of February 2025. The update contained the [[Badlands II]] mini-rework, as well as a new {{ Color |Other|Game Master}} skin for the [[Crook Boss]], based on the popular show [[wp:Squid Game|Squid Game]]. This update contains seven updates, the main v1.51.0 (released 5 February 2025) and six minor updates, v1.51.1 (released 5 February 2025), v1.52.2 (released 5 February 2025), v1.52.3 (released 5 February 2025), v1.52.4 (released 5 February 2025), v1.52.4a (released 5 February 2025) and v1.52.4b (released 12 February 2025).
